what: The first A->M->G online month with the site's MPS (tag gpu-site-AMG) lost every leg to one node: deg0022 of the four GPU nodes could not read the GLADE work filesystem.

symptoms.A: ranks 384-511 of the original Fortran: 'error while loading shared libraries: libblosc.so.1: cannot open' (exited 143 after six minutes)
symptoms.M: 128 ranks on deg0022: "Couldn't change directory to <repo>: Stale file handle"
symptoms.G: the same on deg0022; the site's MPS reported no refused rank

diagnosis: A node-level filesystem fault (a stale GLADE handle on deg0022), not the model, the image or MPS: the mirror job 7588126 (G->M->A, other nodes) ran all three legs to the end.
disposition: The A->M->G order was submitted again under the same tag; the incomplete record it wrote was replaced by that run's.
